## What is wrong?

Identify the document section or application behavior.

## Expected result

Describe what should happen.

## Reproduce or locate it

List the steps or exact file/requirement ID. For a future application issue, include the relevant app, corpus and configuration versions.

## Evidence

Provide a minimal example or screenshot with secrets and personal data removed.

## Impact

Explain which user need is affected and whether the issue blocks further work.
